# FindMy

> A South African local discovery homepage for food, travel, services, property, events, and cars.

## Pages
- [Home](/): Explore categories, collections, FAQs, and local discovery information.
- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): Published route index.

## Available actions
- Use the homepage search to jump to a relevant category preview.
- Choose a city from the hero location selector.
- Explore the sample listings and category cards. Sample listings are for layout preview and are not live results.
- Expand FAQ answers with native disclosure controls.

Newsletter subscription, account creation, business listings, and live search results are not connected in this preview.
